cases.evidence: Deliberate pointer-travel probe on the Feb bar (rect x=382.4, w=38.1). On hover the .vtip shows 'Feb - 612 kWh - $84.10 - 18% below your 12-mo avg' at opacity 1, pointer-events:none, left edge at pointer+13px. Stepping the pointer right in 6px increments: pointer 398/404/410/416 -> tip left 411/417/423/429, pointerInsideTip=false at every step (the tooltip runs away at exactly the pointer's speed); at pointer x=422 — just past the bar's right edge of 420.6 — opacity drops to 0. A single direct jump onto the tooltip body (697,290) also yields opacity 0. So the pointer can never be moved over the additional content: HOVERABLE FAILS. Pressing Escape while still hovering the bar leaves opacity at 1 (before 1, after 1): DISMISSIBLE FAILS. Bars carry tabindex=null, so there is no focus path either.
cases.reasoning: Davin claims the page fails dismissible only and that hoverability is fine. The probe refutes the hoverable half directly: the overlay is pinned to cursor+12/-8 and re-positions on every mousemove, so it is unreachable, and stepping off the bar to reach it fires mouseleave and hides it. The corpus claim that both hoverable and dismissible fail is correct as shipped. The pipeline's standing note that the doc over-credits pointer-events:none as the headline cause (the real driver is mouseleave-hide plus cursor-following) is a pre-existing prose imprecision, and it is not what Davin raised.
